description: This file defines a static catalog for device model identifiers and their corresponding representations, including functions for presenting device information with associated symbols. It includes loading of JSON data resources for device identifiers, mapping logic for device family and model identification, and methods for resource bundle localization.

classes.name: NameValue
classes.description: A decodable enum representing either a string or an array of strings, used for decoding device identifier mappings from JSON.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Returns a DevicePresentation object containing a title and symbol for a given device family and model identifier.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines a symbol string representing the device, based on family and model identifier inputs.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Provides a specific symbol based on the model identifier and friendly name, implementing prefix matching logic.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a fallback symbol based on device family if specific model matching fails.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads and merges device identifier mappings from resource JSON files into a dictionary.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads device identifier mappings from a specified resource JSON file.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Detects the appropriate resource bundle containing device identifier JSON files, checking main and module bundles.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks if a given bundle contains the necessary resource files for device models.
